pages.wave1_intro: You follow the signal west through the mist, towards the ruins of High Nest.
pages.wave1_intro_ability_rules:
Invulnerable (Boss): Starts without a monster token. After being damaged by an attack, place a monster token on it. While it has the token, the next delver attack deals no damage - then remove the token.

Evasive (Boss and Minions): These enemies suffer half damage, rounding up, unless both delvers are adjacent to it.
pages.q7_w1_end: The last Emberwing gutters out in the mist.
pages.q7_w1_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q7_w1_continue:
The road to High Nest is wide and full of potholes, with many lanes littered with long-abandoned vehicles. You scavenge some material that could come in handy.

Delvers gain a Level card.
pages.q7_w1_retreat:
The Emberwings leave you scorched and staggering, each step heavier than the last. The path ahead flickers with danger you can't withstand. You turn back, letting the ruins fade into the mist.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q7_w2_end: Anna the Snake lies still among the wrecks.
pages.q7_w2_defeat: The creatures swarm you and you black out. Your Quest is ended.
pages.q7_w2_continue:
As you begin ascending again, you think back on your history lessons. High Nest was the largest of the seven nests established after the Great Calamity, and the first to fall. Back then it was called First Nest, but almost no one uses that name anymore.

Delvers heal up to 3 HP.
pages.q7_w2_retreat:
The Snatchers' bites leave you bleeding and unsteady, your strength slipping away. Knowing the path ahead offers only more teeth in the dark, you choose survival.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q7_w3_end: Winona the Oak crashes down across the road.
pages.q7_w3_defeat:
The swarm crashes over you, and the world fades to black. When you come to, Witness is carrying you. Whatever awaits you in the ruins will wait a little longer.

Your Quest is ended.
pages.q7_w3_ridge: The entrance to the ruin begins at the apex of a high ridge. Back in Bird's Nest, read "Quest #07 Conclusion".
pages.q7_w1_notes:
The road to High Nest is wide and full of potholes, with many lanes littered with long-abandoned vehicles.

Xavier is your co-pilot today. "Do you see that mound off in the distance? A friend of mine lives there - you should pop in and say hello for me."

Elias's distress-signal notes list the frequencies he monitored - and a relay station along this very road. Inside, still wired to a dead transmitter, sits one of his ion cells, fully charged.

You scavenge some material that could come in handy.

Add Shop Product #35 Ion Battery to your Purchasable Products. Gain a LEVEL UP card.

pages.q7_w2_continue_a:
As you begin ascending again, you think back on your history lessons. High Nest was the largest of the seven nests established after the Great Calamity, and the first to fall. Back then it was called First Nest, but almost no one uses that name anymore.

Samantha is guiding you through the comms, but she's backseat driving. "Careful with that suspension hook - always lift from the ventrical. And your flick capacitor is a bit overactive today, so easy on the release valve. Oh, and..." It's constant.

She takes it well and focuses on offering useful advice.

Gain a LEVEL UP card. Both delvers heal 3 HP.
pages.q7_w2_continue_b:
As you begin ascending again, you think back on your history lessons. High Nest was the largest of the seven nests established after the Great Calamity, and the first to fall. Back then it was called First Nest, but almost no one uses that name anymore.

Samantha is guiding you through the comms, but she's backseat driving. "Careful with that suspension hook - always lift from the ventrical. And your flick capacitor is a bit overactive today, so easy on the release valve. Oh, and..." It's constant.

Her advice is convoluted, but she's trying so hard. She promises to make it up to you.

Increase Samantha's opinion. Both delvers heal 3 HP.
